text:
Hi, I’m Noor Halden, a machine learning engineer with 6 years of experience building Python-based ML solutions, from computer vision systems to model deployment pipelines.

In a recent project for Halvorsen Ceramics, I built a camera-based crack and chip detector using Python, PyTorch, YOLOv8, OpenCV, and ONNX. The system ran on an industrial PC beside the kiln line, and it achieved 97.4% recall on cracks while reducing false rejects from 8% to 2.1%. That work required careful data preparation, model training and retraining, testing, and practical deployment in a production environment.

I also worked on a model deployment pipeline migration for a confidential insurance client. I moved 9 pricing models from hand-copied pickles to an MLflow registry with automated tests and SageMaker endpoints. That cut deploy time from 2 days to 35 minutes, with no downtime during migration. This experience translates well to your need for version control, testing, deployment, and converting programs into API-based access.

Your role is a strong fit for my background in Python, machine learning, PyTorch, scikit-learn, pandas, XGBoost, NLP, Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, and the OpenAI API. I’m comfortable designing ML systems, running experiments, fine-tuning based on test results, and troubleshooting issues quickly. I also have hands-on OpenCV experience, which is directly relevant to your computer vision requirements.

I’d be especially interested in the GIS, GDAL, raster, and orthomosaic/orthorectification side of the work. I’m used to learning domain-specific tooling and translating product requirements into reliable Python programs and testable ML workflows.

What would be the first target use case or dataset for this role, and which GIS or raster libraries are already in place?
